metadata.layerNumbering: R01 at Z=+247 through R14 at Z=-247; L1 starts at the smallest radius.
metadata.azimuthNumbering: A01 is MATLAB generator column 1 (theta=-83.571428571 degrees); viewed from +Z, column angles increase counterclockwise.
metadata.boxConvention: MagTetris rotates local +Y as the N direction: Rz(yaw)*Ry(pitch)*Rx(roll).
metadata.vertexOrder: sign_r in [-1,+1], then sign_theta in [-1,+1], then sign_z in [-1,+1]; vertices are geometric points, not manufacturing allowances.
metadata.slotAllowanceNote: Magnet nominal geometry only. Slot clearance, walls, tolerances and cutter corner relief are not specified by MATLAB.
